statements.status_notes: KubeVirt 1.6.x-1.8.x builds with opencontainers/runc v1.2.8, whose libcontainer cgroup-device implementation calls cilium/ebpf ProgramInfo.RunCount and Runtime and pins cilium/ebpf v0.16.0. KubeVirt 1.9.x uses opencontainers/cgroups v0.0.6, which calls the same APIs and pins cilium/ebpf v0.17.3. Those APIs are unavailable in cilium/ebpf v0.22.0, the first release containing the CVE fix, so forcing v0.22.0 causes virt-chroot to fail to compile. Impact remains under investigation pending a compatible cgroups/runc update or backport.
